question: Collect papers that show low-power adapters reducing edge robot telemetry energy.

candidate_papers.title: LoRA telemetry adapters for edge robots
candidate_papers.text: Low-power LoRA adapters reduce edge robot telemetry energy by compressing sensor updates before radio transmission.

candidate_papers.title: Spiking adapters for telemetry throttling
candidate_papers.text: A spiking adapter lowers edge robot telemetry energy by emitting sparse event packets during idle motion.

candidate_papers.title: Drone battery pack comparison
candidate_papers.text: This battery comparison studies pack chemistry and flight time, not low-power telemetry adapters.

candidate_papers.title: Sleep-gate adapters for robot telemetry
candidate_papers.text: Sleep-gate adapters reduce edge robot telemetry energy by suppressing unchanged payload fields between checkpoints.

candidate_papers.title: Cloud dashboard latency
candidate_papers.text: The dashboard paper improves visualization latency but does not measure edge robot telemetry energy reduction.
